_notes: Read from saves/Unmatched Official Tournament Table October 2026 (Hellboy).json (read only): infinite bag 3efeee > bag c592d8. Every GUID comes from that inner bag and is kept when its objects are taken out.

fighters: by HeroDef fighter id (piece = GUID of the miniature or token; a list if the GUID changes when the state changes; dial = life dial; dial_max = MAX_VALUE of its script). Without a dial = 1 HP piece.

deck.card_ids = CardID range of the 30 cards; character_card_id goes inside the same physical deck (31 cards) but outside the range. deck.identity = (FaceURL, BackURL) of the sheet: what identifies the deck (the CardID is not enough).

ability.note: Z rotation of the ability token for each face; rotZ 180 = OCCULT DETECTIVE (blue, start), rotZ 0 = ANUNG UN RAMA (red), inferred from the geometry of the glued child. Confirm with --read-only and one live flip. Form states of the miniature are its piece GUIDs in order (state index = position + 1).
